TextBlock.Text: Echium: Lanaria, my Dearest: for you I have devised and adventure that I believe you will be most fond of.
Lanaria: Echium? What is this, a game? I do hope it has more thought out rules this time.
Echium: Not just any game; a Treasure Hunt! I have discreetly laid out clues around this planet to a gift you could not refuse. I wish you luck, my dearest!
Echium: Your first clue is: Within the pedestal upon which you belong.
